expected_behavior: Replaces System.out and printStackTrace with the SLF4J facade using parameterized key={} messages, exception passed as last argument
Uses the full level palette: INFO start/outcome with identifiers and counts, DEBUG per-line detail, WARN for skipped lines and a distinct partial-success outcome signal
Adds orderId/requestId to MDC and removes those keys (MDC.remove, not MDC.clear) in finally, since the filter owns the traceId
Never logs cardNumber, email, name, address, or whole request objects
Adds a Micrometer Timer on the fulfill path and a Counter for failed lines, with low-cardinality names and no per-order tags
Preserves the original control flow (telemetry changes no behavior)
Any manual duration log or Timer.Sample.stop is placed in a finally block (or Timer.record is used) — never a duration statement after the call that an exception would skip
Uses Micrometer (Timer) rather than a hand-rolled duration metric
Metric name is stable and low-cardinality (no per-customer/per-payment tags)
Flags + concatenation and converts to parameterized {} placeholders
Flags System.out and the java.util.logging introduction (use the project facade only)
Flags log.error(e.getMessage()) for dropping the stack trace — pass the exception as the last argument
Flags the token and request body as sensitive data that must not be logged at any level
